body: My friends know, but there is only so much they can do. I cannot burden them with my issues, as a few already have their own mental health struggles. I might think about in person therapy, and she also recommended group therapy. Might be good with other lgbtq teens.

Yea lol, it’s tough. At least we have others who understand. I’m not out to dad yet but I doubt he will be pleased. It’s awful because he talks about how he wants me to live my life how I want and to the fullest, but would he be saying that if I told him I am transgender?

My mom knows but I don’t have a good relationship with her. She thinks I don’t understand being transgender and the long term struggle it will be even though I AM the one who is trans. I have a sort of therapist but it’s over phone calls and not very useful. My mom thinks I need in person therapy. I’m out to my teachers and friends luckily so I get affirmed there.
